prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE polished landscape fantasy weapon concept illustration / design comparison sheet, three equally sized vertical panels on a dark charcoal background. This is a proposed grip redesign for a Skyrim geometric solid-light bow series called Arcane Armory. The main subject in EACH panel is a large clear three-quarter close-up of the bow's central grip and the roots of its upper and lower limbs; a much smaller full-length bow silhouette stands alongside it to show proportion. Three genuinely distinct grip structures, all sharing a precise SIX-pointed hexagram made of TWO overlapping equilateral triangle outlines, never a five-point star. A substantial practical hand grip is visible BEHIND the emblem. The star is part of the weapon, not a floating draw spell.

Shared art direction: entirely clean thick faceted geometric beams, hollow frames, straight folded segments, no organic sculpture, no metal/leather/wrappings/jewels/engraving. Solid dark ruby-red light material with restrained narrow scarlet luminous bevel edges. Attractive sophisticated dimensional bevels and readable thickness, mild glow only; preserve dark red planes, no white-hot centers or broad bloom. Sparse tiny red geometric motes near upper and lower joints only. Grip joins should smoothly taper into repeated open hexagonal bow-wing modules. Emblem and joints must look integrated, deliberate and balanced, while keeping the middle usable as a handhold. SAME red palette, comparable close-up scale and identical simple outer bow-wing design in all panels, so comparison focuses on grip. No people, hands, arrows, environment, UI, logo or watermark.

Panel A, exact small title "A  星核悬环": a thick hexagram suspended slightly in front of a prismatic grip, inside TWO separated open segments of a hexagonal outer frame. Clear intentional gaps left and right. Short angular tapered bridges join the outer frame to the upper and lower bow roots. Airy suspended nested structure, controlled negative space, star entirely legible.
Panel B, exact small title "B  双翼抱星": the upper bow root splits into two stout geometric folded arms pointing downwards and inwards; the lower root splits into two matching arms pointing upwards and inwards. These four short shoulder arms cradle the four oblique corners of a SINGLE thick hexagram, like upper/lower wings embracing the star. Leave open left and right sides and open windows around the star. The star has shallow prismatic depth and thin bright chamfers. This should be the strongest, most cohesive and aesthetically compelling silhouette, not a circular medallion or enormous guard.
Panel C, exact small title "C  叠星棱柱": one clear primary thick hexagram in front of a slightly smaller darker hexagram behind it, aligned parallel with modest physical depth separation, forming a compact stepped solid-light assembly. The three-quarter angle clearly shows short bridges and faceted cross-sections. A thicker hexagonal-section central handgrip and simple tapered geometric sockets connect to bow roots. Layering must be clean and restrained, not many overlapping confusing lines.

Editorial presentation: generous margins, fine subtle panel separators, elegant small readable Chinese titles at the bottom, no extra labels or paragraph text. Large grip close-ups dominate; the corresponding small complete bows must fit from tip to tip and each show a taut red string attached to two limb tips. High quality detailed professional game weapon concept painting, precise clean silhouettes, sculptural depth, entirely geometric and plausible to model. Wide canvas approximately 3:2.
